name: publicWeb_getLandingPageData
description: Returns kennel identity and website configuration needed to render a public-web landing page, looked up by URL slug (KennelUniqueShortName), for a live kennel (deleted = 0, removed = 0). Theming comes from HC.KennelWebsite where configured: ThemeMode, ScrollBlur, WebsiteTitleText, Tagline and WelcomeText fall back to hardcoded platform defaults; every other style column is NULL without a KennelWebsite row and the frontend applies its own default. KennelStatus lets hashruns.org show the logo-only holding page for Defunct (3) and Inactive - Hidden (4) kennels; DistancePreference (2026-09-27) picks m/km or yd/mi on PackTrack pages. No authentication. Read-only.

parameters.name: kennelUniqueShortName
parameters.description: The kennel's URL slug — must match exactly (case-insensitive collation applies at DB level) Defaults to NULL when omitted (2026-10-13).

rowsets.name: ValidationError
rowsets.description: Instead of the normal rowsets when a guard fails (slug blank, or longer than 50 characters; lines 52-62). Not logged to HC.ErrorLog. The SP returns.

columns.name: ErrorMessage
columns.description: Fixed text describing the bad input.

rowsets.name: KennelLandingPage
rowsets.description: Single row when a live kennel has this slug; empty when not found, deleted or removed — the caller treats it as a 404. Defunct / hidden kennels still return a row (see KennelStatus).

columns.name: PublicKennelId
columns.description: Public kennel GUID. Safe to expose — used by subsequent public-web SPs (e.g. publicWeb_getEvents) that take a GUID key instead of the URL slug.

columns.name: KennelName
columns.description: Full kennel name (e.g. 'London Hash House Harriers')

columns.name: KennelShortName
columns.description: Display short name (e.g. 'LH3')

columns.name: KennelUniqueShortName
columns.description: URL slug — echoed back from input so the caller can confirm the match

columns.name: KennelDescription
columns.description: Free-text description of the kennel. NULL when not set.

columns.name: KennelLogo
columns.description: Logo URL from HC.Kennel.KennelLogo. NOT NULL — but may be a bundle:// ref (e.g. 'bundle://defaultKennelLogo') for kennels that have not uploaded a logo. Callers must check for an https:// prefix before rendering as an image.

columns.name: FaviconUrl
columns.description: Favicon URL from HC.Kennel.KennelFavicon. NULL when not set. Callers must check for https:// prefix.

columns.name: BannerImage
columns.description: Hero/header banner image URL from KennelWebsite.BannerImage. NULL when not set.

columns.name: WebsiteBackgroundImage
columns.description: Background image URL from KennelWebsite.BackgroundImage. NULL when not set — frontend uses the platform default tile in that case. Not inherited from FILTH.

columns.name: ThemeMode
columns.description: Theme mode for the kennel website: 'light' or 'dark'. Defaults to 'dark' when not configured.

columns.name: PrimaryColor
columns.description: CSS hex primary brand colour (e.g. '#dc2626'). Injected as --kennel-primary. NULL when not configured — frontend uses its own default.

columns.name: AccentColor
columns.description: CSS hex accent colour. Injected as --kennel-accent; falls back to PrimaryColor in the frontend when NULL.

columns.name: ScrollBlur
columns.description: Scroll blur intensity: 0 = no blur, 100 = full blur (40px CSS blur). Defaults to 0 when not configured.

columns.name: OgImageUrl
columns.description: Open Graph image URL (1200×630px recommended). Used when pages are shared on social/messaging. NULL when not set.

columns.name: WebsiteTitleText
columns.description: Custom display name shown in the hero below the logo. COALESCE(KennelWebsite.TitleText, Kennel.KennelName) — always non-null.

columns.name: Tagline
columns.description: Short strapline. COALESCE(KennelWebsite.Tagline, 'A Drinking Club with a Running Problem') — always non-null.

columns.name: WelcomeText
columns.description: Homepage welcome/intro copy. COALESCE(KennelWebsite.WelcomeText, hardcoded platform default) — always non-null.

columns.name: SeoTitle
columns.description: Per-tenant <title> tag override. NULL when not set — caller constructs a default title from KennelName.

columns.name: SeoDescription
columns.description: Per-tenant <meta description>. NULL when not set.

columns.name: SeoStructuredDataJson
columns.description: JSON-LD structured data override. NULL when not set — caller generates a default from kennel identity fields.

columns.name: CustomDomain
columns.description: Tier 3 custom domain (e.g. 'lh3.com'). NULL = subdomain-only kennel (tier 2).

columns.name: WebsiteEnabled
columns.description: KennelWebsite.Enabled (a BIT column — serialised as JSON true/false by the shim). NULL when no KennelWebsite row exists.

columns.name: KennelStatus
columns.description: Kennel.KennelStatus (DomainValues.KennelStatusEnum) — 3 Defunct and 4 Inactive - Hidden render the logo-only holding page.

columns.name: TitleTextColor
columns.description: HC6 style token: heading and event-name text colour (#RRGGBBAA). NULL = frontend uses #FFFFFFFF.

columns.name: BodyTextColor
columns.description: HC6 style token: body and row-value text colour (#RRGGBBAA). NULL = frontend uses #FFFFFFFF.

columns.name: TextMutedColor
columns.description: HC6 style token: secondary / label text colour (#RRGGBBAA). NULL = frontend uses #FFFFFF80 (50% white).

columns.name: CardBackgroundColor
columns.description: HC6 style token: card and panel surface colour (#RRGGBBAA). NULL = frontend uses #FFFFFF0A (dark) or #FFFFFFFF (light).

columns.name: ButtonPrimaryColor
columns.description: HC6 style token: primary action button background (#RRGGBBAA). NULL = frontend falls back to --kennel-primary via CSS var().

columns.name: ButtonCancelColor
columns.description: HC6 style token: cancel/undo action button background (#RRGGBBAA). NULL = no override.

columns.name: ButtonSecondaryColor
columns.description: HC6 style token: secondary (non-primary, non-cancel) button background (#RRGGBBAA). NULL = frontend uses rgba(255,255,255,0.08) glassmorphism fallback.

columns.name: RunCardColor
columns.description: HC6 style token: run card surface colour (#RRGGBBAA). NULL = frontend falls back to --kennel-card-bg via CSS var().

columns.name: WebsiteBackgroundColor
columns.description: HC5 legacy background overlay colour. Used by the frontend for the scroll overlay effect. #RRGGBBAA — the alpha byte encodes max overlay opacity.

columns.name: MenuBackgroundColor
columns.description: HC5 legacy sticky nav background colour. #RRGGBBAA — alpha byte encodes nav background opacity. NULL = frontend uses theme default.

columns.name: MenuTextColor
columns.description: Sticky nav text colour. NULL = frontend uses theme default (white on dark, near-black on light).

columns.name: PageFeaturesJson
columns.description: KennelWebsite.PageFeaturesJson — per-kennel page feature toggles (JSON). NULL when not set.

columns.name: DistancePreference
columns.description: Since 1.3.0 (2026-09-27): COALESCE(Kennel.DistancePreference, Country.DistancePreference, 0). Bit 0: 0 = km, 1 = miles. Used by public PackTrack pages to show m/km or yd/mi.

columns.name: SocialLinksJson
columns.description: The kennel's PUBLIC social links (E12.F4.S4) via HC6.KennelSocialLinksVisible(…, 0); members-only entries are left out because this page is public and cached. NULL = none.

rowsets.name: CatchEnvelope
rowsets.description: On a runtime error (CATCH, line 134): { Success = 0, ErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE() }, possibly after rowsets already sent. NOT logged to HC.ErrorLog and not re-raised.

columns.name: ErrorMessage
columns.description: ERROR_MESSAGE().

codeSmells.issue: CATCH does not log to HC.ErrorLog
codeSmells.detail: The CATCH (lines 133-135) returns { Success = 0, ErrorMessage } without writing HC.ErrorLog and without THROW, so a timeout or bad input surfaces to the shim as a data rowset and leaves no server-side record (CLAUDE.md 'Every CATCH must log').

Lines 58-62 reject a slug longer than 50 characters, but @kennelUniqueShortName is NVARCHAR(50): a longer value is silently truncated to 50 when bound, so the check can never fire and a long slug is looked up by its first 50 characters.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change ThemeMode values without updating all frontend theme consumers
Never change ScrollBlur range (0–100) without updating the frontend mapping
